en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: He said: "I asked him, 'Can a fasting person perform cupping (hijamah)?' Imam (as) replied: 'I fear for him what he might fear for himself.'
I asked: 'What do you fear for him?' Imam (as) said: 'Fainting or the stirring of bile.'
I asked: 'What if he is strong enough and does not fear anything?' Imam (as) said: 'Yes, if he wishes.'"
